title: The Choir of the Glass Steppe Revisited
author: Lior Hartwell
blurb: Petra Villalobos, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
